El Loco.sig: A new beginning opens before you with fresh energy. It is the moment to take a leap into the void with confidence, leaving attachments behind. Innocence and spontaneity are your allies; the path is revealed by walking it.
El Loco.revesSig: There is a risk of acting with too much impetuosity or without watching where you step. Check whether you are avoiding an important responsibility under the guise of freedom.

El Mago.sig: You have all the necessary resources at your disposal to manifest your intention. The tools (cups, pentacles, swords, wands) are on the table. The key is to align will, thought, emotion, and action.
El Mago.revesSig: The talent exists but is being wasted through lack of focus or manipulative use. Beware of whoever promises more than they can deliver, including yourself.

La Suma Sacerdotisa.sig: The answer does not come from outside but from your inner voice. It is a time for stillness, listening, and receptivity. Something still hidden will be revealed in due time.
La Suma Sacerdotisa.revesSig: You are ignoring your intuition or repressing something that needs to come to light. Secrets, your own or others', are weighing heavily.

La Emperatriz.sig: Flowering, creativity, and emotional and material abundance. It is a time to care, nurture, and let grow. What has been sown begins to bear fruit.
La Emperatriz.revesSig: There may be overprotection, emotional dependence, or creativity stifled by external demands. Reclaim your space of self-nurturing.

El Emperador.sig: It is a time to put things in order, set boundaries, and take on responsibilities with discipline. Structure creates freedom; without it everything crumbles.
El Emperador.revesSig: Either there is excess of control and rigidity (toward oneself or others), or a lack of structure that leaves everything adrift. Find the middle ground.

El Hierofante.sig: The wisdom of tradition, a mentor, or an established belief system offers guidance. It is wise to follow a recognized path before inventing your own.
El Hierofante.revesSig: You are questioning an inherited belief or a system that no longer represents you. Rebellion is legitimate if accompanied by a clear direction of your own.

Los Enamorados.sig: A meaningful choice, especially regarding partnership or values. What you decide should align mind and heart. True union is born of free choice, not attachment.
Los Enamorados.revesSig: There is indecision or a choice made from desire rather than from values. A relationship or alliance presents disharmony that must be faced.

El Carro.sig: After a period of effort and balance between opposing forces, advance and victory arrive. Keep your course and do not loosen the reins just yet.
El Carro.revesSig: The internal forces are unbalanced and the chariot swerves. Either you drift aimlessly, or you charge with poorly channeled aggression.

La Fuerza.sig: True strength is not imposition but patience and love. What seemed untamable yields before serene constancy and kind courage.
La Fuerza.revesSig: Doubts and lack of confidence weaken your position. There is repressed anger or passion that needs to be expressed in a healthy way.

El Ermitaño.sig: It is a time to withdraw from external noise to hear the inner voice. The light you seek you carry within; solitude now is medicinal.
El Ermitaño.revesSig: Isolation has become excessive or imposed. Beware of locking yourself in your head and rejecting the help of those who light your path.

La Rueda de la Fortuna.sig: A change of cycle is approaching, almost always favorable. What goes up comes down and what goes down comes up; take advantage of the momentum while it lasts and be grateful for what arrives.
La Rueda de la Fortuna.revesSig: Resisting change prolongs stagnation. If the wheel is going down, let go; the sooner you accept the cycle, the sooner it will turn around.

La Justicia.sig: Things balance according to what has been sown. Fair and transparent decisions are now the right path. What has been done has its consequence.
La Justicia.revesSig: There is an injustice, your own or external, that must be corrected. Or you are evading taking on the responsibility that falls to you.

El Colgado.sig: Progress has halted, but it is not stagnation, rather a sacred pause. Releasing control and seeing things from another angle will bring revelation.
El Colgado.revesSig: You are hanging but without the spirit of learning; there is resistance to letting go or a martyr posture that helps no one.

La Muerte.sig: A cycle closes so that another may be born. The symbolic death of the old is necessary; resisting only prolongs the pain. Trust: what comes is more authentic.
La Muerte.revesSig: You cling to something that has already fulfilled its cycle. Change is happening anyway, but resistance makes it more painful.

La Templanza.sig: It is a time to blend patiently, without extremes. Temperance is the art of combining opposites and finding the healing middle ground.
La Templanza.revesSig: There is excess or imbalance in some area. Extreme rhythms wear you down; it is wise to return to center.

El Diablo.sig: There is an attachment, an addiction, or a bond based on fear or desire that keeps you bound. Recognizing the chain is the first step to breaking it; the key is in your hand.
El Diablo.revesSig: You begin to see the chains and free yourself from them. Recognizing your own shadow returns the power you had surrendered.

La Torre.sig: Something built on false foundations collapses. Although the impact hurts, what falls is what prevented building on solid ground. The truth liberates, even if it frightens.
La Torre.revesSig: You are avoiding an inevitable collapse or holding back a truth that needs to come out. The longer you take to let go, the greater the impact.

La Estrella.sig: After the storm of The Tower, the light returns. It is a time to heal, to reconnect with hope, and to trust in the flow of life. You are guided.
La Estrella.revesSig: Hope has been temporarily extinguished. Reconnecting with what inspires you, even a small light, will reactivate your faith.

La Luna.sig: There is fog and ambiguity; not all is as it seems. Fears from the unconscious surface. Trust intuition over appearance.
La Luna.revesSig: The fog begins to clear and fears lose their power. A truth that was hidden becomes visible.

El Sol.sig: Light, success, and joy arrive. Everything looks clear and positive. It is a time to celebrate, shine, and reconnect with the inner child who delights without reason.
El Sol.revesSig: Joy is temporarily clouded or based on appearances. Success is postponed but not cancelled; check whether the ego is unbalancing the light.

El Juicio.sig: An inner or outer calling summons you to a rebirth. It is a time to listen, forgive the past, and respond to a higher calling.
El Juicio.revesSig: Excessive self-criticism or guilt prevents you from hearing the call. Forgiveness, starting with yourself, opens the door again.

El Mundo.sig: A cycle completes with success. You have integrated the lessons and are now whole. It is a time to celebrate and prepare for a new beginning at another level.
El Mundo.revesSig: A final stretch remains to close the cycle. Something is loose or unintegrated; identify what is missing before declaring it finished.

As de Copas.sig: A new emotion or bond blossoms in your heart. Allow yourself to feel without reservation.
As de Copas.revesSig: An emotion has not dared to come out, or a bonding opportunity has been let pass.

2 de Copas.sig: Two souls meet as equals. Union, partnership, or mutual attraction with harmony.
2 de Copas.revesSig: Balance is broken in a relationship; review what separates what once united.

3 de Copas.sig: A time to celebrate with friends or community. Shared joy multiplies.
3 de Copas.revesSig: Social excess or the presence of third parties disturbs harmony. Beware of gossip.

4 de Copas.sig: Discontent makes you ignore an offered opportunity. Look up, not all is lost.
4 de Copas.revesSig: You emerge from apathy and begin to see what was being offered. Motivation returns.

5 de Copas.sig: There is a loss to mourn, but cups remain standing. Do not look only at what is spilled.
5 de Copas.revesSig: You begin to accept the loss and recover what still remains standing.

6 de Copas.sig: A return to the past, to childhood, or a reunion. Nostalgia can be a balm or a trap.
6 de Copas.revesSig: You are too anchored to the past. It is time to let go and look to the future.

7 de Copas.sig: Many options present themselves, but some are mirages. You need clarity to choose with your feet on the ground.
7 de Copas.revesSig: The fog clears and you make a clear decision. Options reduce to what is real.

8 de Copas.sig: You leave behind something that no longer fulfills you to seek a deeper meaning. The inner journey begins.
8 de Copas.revesSig: You want to leave something but fear holds you back. Review whether it is attachment or prudence.

9 de Copas.sig: What you wished for comes true. Enjoy it, without falling into self-complacency.
9 de Copas.revesSig: The fulfilled wish does not satisfy as you expected, or excess leaves you empty.

10 de Copas.sig: Emotional and family harmony reaches its peak. The rainbow appears after the rain.
10 de Copas.revesSig: There are tensions in the family or emotional sphere that require attention.

Sota de Copas.sig: A message from the heart or a new sensitivity awakens. Pay attention to your dreams and premonitions.
Sota de Copas.revesSig: Immature or capricious emotions dominate. It is wise to wait before acting from emotion.

Caballero de Copas.sig: A romance, an affectionate proposal, or a creative impulse arrives with chivalry.
Caballero de Copas.revesSig: Beware of empty promises or jealousy that clouds your sight. The idealized clashes with reality.

Reina de Copas.sig: Deep empathy and the capacity to provide emotional support. Your intuition is your best guide now.
Reina de Copas.revesSig: You absorb too much in others' emotions and become overwhelmed. Care for your own boundaries.

Rey de Copas.sig: Emotional maturity, calm in the storm, and diplomacy to resolve conflicts. You are the master of your emotions, not their slave.
Rey de Copas.revesSig: There is emotional manipulation, your own or others', or a poorly managed inner storm.

As de Oros.sig: A material or professional opportunity presents itself. It is a seed that, cared for, will bear stable fruit.
As de Oros.revesSig: A material opportunity is wasted through lack of attention or anxiety. Review your priorities.

2 de Oros.sig: You are balancing several priorities with flexibility. Constant movement is part of the game now.
2 de Oros.revesSig: Too many open fronts and little balance. It is wise to let something go before everything falls.

3 de Oros.sig: Your work and talent are recognized in collaboration with others. The sum of competences makes the work.
3 de Oros.revesSig: There are disagreements at work or poorly used talent. Review communication with your team.

4 de Oros.sig: You need to conserve what you have earned, but careful: excessive control can become avarice.
4 de Oros.revesSig: You begin to release control or material attachment. Generosity restores the flow.

5 de Oros.sig: A feeling of material or spiritual scarcity. Help is near; do not isolate yourself out of pride.
5 de Oros.revesSig: Scarcity recedes and recovery begins. You accept the help that was being offered.

6 de Oros.sig: You find the balance between giving and receiving. Conscious generosity creates healthy bonds.
6 de Oros.revesSig: There is imbalance between what you give and receive, or help with ulterior motives. Review the terms.

7 de Oros.sig: A pause to evaluate what has been sown. There is no rush to harvest; observe what ripens and what does not.
7 de Oros.revesSig: Waiting becomes impatience or the investment does not pay off as you expected. Review the strategy.

8 de Oros.sig: Concentrated work and dedication to detail. Mastery is built with patience and repetition.
8 de Oros.revesSig: Discouragement or excessive perfectionism slows progress. Recover practical sense.

9 de Oros.sig: Effort and discipline bear fruit. You enjoy well-being and earned independence.
9 de Oros.revesSig: Material insecurity or excess attachment to having clouds what is truly valuable.

10 de Oros.sig: Lasting stability, legacy, or inheritance arrives. What has been built transcends to the family.
10 de Oros.revesSig: There are tensions in the family legacy or loss of accumulated material stability.

Sota de Oros.sig: A new learning opportunity or a message about studies and work. Good disposition.
Sota de Oros.revesSig: Lack of focus or laziness toward what requires constancy. Rekindle the interest.

Caballero de Oros.sig: Slow but inexorable advance. Responsibility and patience are now your best allies.
Caballero de Oros.revesSig: Constancy becomes stagnation or soulless routine. You need a new goal.

Reina de Oros.sig: Practicality and care. You know how to sustain livelihood and offer stability to your own.
Reina de Oros.revesSig: Fear of scarcity or excess attachment to security disconnects you from simple pleasure.

Rey de Oros.sig: Material leadership and strategic vision. You know how to turn ideas into tangible and stable realities.
Rey de Oros.revesSig: Attachment to material power or stubbornness makes you lose perspective. Recalibrate your priorities.

As de Espadas.sig: A flash of clarity allows you to see the truth and cut away what does not serve. It is a time to decide with a cool mind.
As de Espadas.revesSig: Clarity clouds or the sword cuts without aim. Beware of hurtful words.

2 de Espadas.sig: You are in a dilemma you do not want to see. Covering your eyes solves nothing; you need information.
2 de Espadas.revesSig: The blindfold falls and the decision clarifies. What you avoided looking at becomes visible.

3 de Espadas.sig: An acute emotional pain, a breakup, or a truth that hurts. The pain is real but passing; the rain cleanses the heart.
3 de Espadas.revesSig: The pain begins to heal. Forgiveness, starting with yourself, accelerates recovery.

4 de Espadas.sig: A necessary pause to recover body and mind. Rest now is productive, not evasion.
4 de Espadas.revesSig: You return to activity after rest, or rest is interrupted before its time.

5 de Espadas.sig: There is conflict and someone ends up losing. A victory obtained at others' expense is not a real victory.
5 de Espadas.revesSig: The conflict calms and the door opens to reconciliation. What seemed lost is negotiated.

6 de Espadas.sig: You move from a difficult situation toward calmer waters. The crossing is not easy but the direction is right.
6 de Espadas.revesSig: Change is delayed by resistance. Returning to the known may seem safe but does not lead to better.

7 de Espadas.sig: Someone acts with cunning, perhaps deceiving. If it is you, check whether the shortcut will cost you dear; if it is another, protect yourself.
7 de Espadas.revesSig: The truth comes to light; masks fall. It is wise to confess before being discovered.

8 de Espadas.sig: You feel trapped, but the bonds are largely mental. The bindings loosen if you move.
8 de Espadas.revesSig: You realize the prison was largely self-imposed. You begin to see the way out.

9 de Espadas.sig: Mental fears are amplified at night. What seems catastrophic at 3 AM is usually more manageable by day.
9 de Espadas.revesSig: Anguish recedes and you recover hope. The problem was smaller than it seemed.

10 de Espadas.sig: A painful end, the lowest point of the cycle. But ten is closure: the only thing that follows is dawn.
10 de Espadas.revesSig: You have hit bottom and survived. The worst is now behind; from here you only go up.

Sota de Espadas.sig: A new message or idea demands attention. Stay alert; your mind is quick now.
Sota de Espadas.revesSig: There is gossip or misunderstanding. Mind your words, which can hurt without intent.

Caballero de Espadas.sig: Decisive and quick action, almost reckless. Advance but measure the terrain before charging.
Caballero de Espadas.revesSig: Impulsiveness gets you into trouble. Stop a moment before acting.

Reina de Espadas.sig: Mental clarity and independence. You know how to set boundaries and speak the truth with respect and firmness.
Reina de Espadas.revesSig: Clarity becomes coldness or independence into bitter isolation. Soften the edge.

Rey de Espadas.sig: Authority based on discernment and ethics. Fair decision, clear word, impartial judgment.
Rey de Espadas.revesSig: Intellectual power is used to dominate or manipulate. Beware of whoever imposes 'their' truth.

As de Bastos.sig: A spark of inspiration or a new project ignites your passion. Catch it before it goes out.
As de Bastos.revesSig: The spark goes out before catching, or the project is delayed by lack of internal combustion.

2 de Bastos.sig: You are on the balcony planning the way. You have the map; now you must decide the direction.
2 de Bastos.revesSig: Plans do not materialize for fear of leaving the safety of the known.

3 de Bastos.sig: Your ships set sail; opportunities arrive from afar. The project begins to take scale.
3 de Bastos.revesSig: The ships are delayed or the project meets obstacles. Recalibrate the vision.

4 de Bastos.sig: A milestone is celebrated. You reach a point of stability that deserves recognition.
4 de Bastos.revesSig: Stability wobbles or the reason for celebration is postponed.

5 de Bastos.sig: There is competition or tension, not necessarily destructive. From friction something new may emerge.
5 de Bastos.revesSig: Tension resolves into cooperation or truce. Common ground is found.

6 de Bastos.sig: Triumph and public recognition. You are crowned for your achievements; enjoy without losing your head.
6 de Bastos.revesSig: Triumph is delayed or recognition does not arrive. The wounded ego may react badly.

7 de Bastos.sig: You defend your position from an advantage. Hold your ground even if you are in the minority.
7 de Bastos.revesSig: You feel overwhelmed and yield ground. Recalibrate: what are the positions you defend worth?

8 de Bastos.sig: Things accelerate. Messages, trips, or changes happen quickly. Stay agile.
8 de Bastos.revesSig: Projects slow down due to friction or blockages in communication.

9 de Bastos.sig: You have endured much and still stand. You are wounded but not defeated; one last effort and you arrive.
9 de Bastos.revesSig: Fatigue or excessive defensiveness exhausts you. It is wise to lay down arms and rest.

10 de Bastos.sig: You carry too much. The end of the stretch is near, but review which burdens are truly yours.
10 de Bastos.revesSig: You release burdens that are not yours or delegate. Relief arrives.

Sota de Bastos.sig: A new enthusiasm or a motivating message awakens your energy. Curiosity drives you.
Sota de Bastos.revesSig: Enthusiasm fades quickly or impatience spoils the project. Recover constancy.

Caballero de Bastos.sig: Adventure, charisma, and audacity. You advance with overwhelming energy toward the new.
Caballero de Bastos.revesSig: Audacity becomes recklessness or promises are not kept. Moderate the drive.

Reina de Bastos.sig: Charisma and magnetic confidence. You attract with your presence alone; use it consciously.
Reina de Bastos.revesSig: Insecurity or jealousy tarnishes your shine. Reconnect with your inner source of confidence.

Rey de Bastos.sig: Visionary and charismatic leadership. You inspire others with your energy and clarity of purpose.
Rey de Bastos.revesSig: Leadership becomes authoritarian or the ego overflows. Remember: the true king serves.

1.sig: Primordial creative energy in its pure state. It is the time to act with firmness and clarity, aligning with the natural order. Constant persistence produces lasting works.
1.consejo: Be active, creative, and persistent. Do not force; let the energy flow as the sky unfolds its vastness.

2.sig: Receptive principle that welcomes and nurtures. It is not inert passivity but active availability to sustain what is being gestated. Patience bears fruit.
2.consejo: Do not push, welcome. Follow rather than lead. What is sown now will germinate.

3.sig: Every beginning is difficult. The energies meet in an embryonic state and must make their way through obstacles. Confusion is inherent to birth.
3.consejo: Do not give up before the initial chaos. Seek help, organize little by little, and accept that things take time to take shape.

4.sig: Like a youth seeking to learn, one must admit one's inexperience and seek guidance. Well-directed innocence becomes wisdom.
4.consejo: Acknowledge what you do not know. Seek a teacher or advice. Do not act with arrogance.

5.sig: It is not the time to act but to wait with confidence. Conscious waiting prepares the right moment for action.
5.consejo: Wait without anxiety. Trust that the opportunity will arrive. Prepare in the meantime.

6.sig: There is disagreement between forces. The conflict can escalate if one insists. It is wise to seek mediation and not push to the end.
6.consejo: Do not take the conflict to the extreme. Seek an impartial third party. Yield on the secondary to gain on the essential.

7.sig: Like a well-commanded army, the situation requires discipline, order, and firm but compassionate leadership. Organized collective strength surpasses individualism.
7.consejo: Organize, establish clear hierarchies and discipline. The leader serves the group, not the other way around.

8.sig: The waters converge. It is a time to unite, seek alliances, and strengthen bonds. Solitude is not the way now.
8.consejo: Approach those who share your values. Form a team. Union multiplies strength.

9.sig: Gentle force that contains without repressing. Sustained small efforts achieve more than great ephemeral impulses.
9.consejo: Do not expect great advances. Accumulate small achievements. Modest constancy is your ally.

10.sig: How to behave before power or difference. Proper, prudent, and respectful conduct allows you to advance even in delicate terrain.
10.consejo: Measure your steps, be respectful, act with elegance. Form matters as much as substance.

11.sig: Heaven and earth meet and communicate. It is a time of prosperity, harmony, and fluidity. Everything falls into place naturally.
11.consejo: Enjoy the harmony but do not fall asleep. Take advantage to consolidate what now flows easily.

12.sig: Heaven moves away from earth. The forces do not communicate and everything stagnates. There is an energetic blockage.
12.consejo: Do not force. Accept the stagnation and prepare for when the cycle changes. Cultivate your interior in the meantime.

13.sig: Union with others around a broad and generous purpose. It is not a union of interest but of shared values.
13.consejo: Seek allies around an ideal. Be open and transparent. Community broadens horizons.

14.sig: Great possession, visible success. Abundance requires generosity and magnanimity so as not to become corrupt.
14.consejo: Enjoy what has been achieved with generosity. Share. Well-administered wealth multiplies.

15.sig: The mountain hides beneath the earth. True greatness need not be displayed. Modesty is the virtue that balances everything.
15.consejo: Lower your profile, acknowledge others, do not boast. Modesty opens doors that pride closes.

16.sig: Enthusiastic energy that moves multitudes. Well-directed enthusiasm can inspire great enterprises.
16.consejo: Channel enthusiasm. Inspire others with your motivation. But beware of blind exaltation.

17.sig: Knowing how to follow the moment and adapt to changing circumstances. It is not submission but adaptive intelligence.
17.consejo: Adapt to the flow of events. Follow what works, let go of what resists.

18.sig: Something has become corrupted through neglect and must be repaired. It requires courage to face what is deteriorated and work on its healing.
18.consejo: Face what is spoiled without fear. Clean, repair, heal. It is hard work but necessary.

19.sig: An opportunity approaches. It is a time to advance with confidence, but without rushing. The energy is in your favor.
19.consejo: Advance with decision but without haste. Take advantage of the favorable juncture while it lasts.

20.sig: Observe before acting. As from a watchtower, contemplating the full panorama allows you to understand what would otherwise go unnoticed.
20.consejo: Stop and observe. Do not act yet. Deep understanding precedes accurate action.

21.sig: There is an obstacle that must be cut with decision. Like biting through tough meat, it requires strength and determination to overcome what blocks.
21.consejo: Act with decision and clarity. Cut at the root what gets in the way. Half-measures prolong the problem.

22.sig: The beauty of form. The superficial has its place but must not be confused with substance. Grace adorns without hiding.
22.consejo: Care for form and presentation. The beautiful harmonizes. But do not confuse wrapper with content.

23.sig: Everything crumbles from the base. The old disintegrates so the new can be born. Do not resist, let it fall.
23.consejo: Do not cling to what falls. Accept the stripping away. What survives will be the authentic.

24.sig: After winter comes the return of light. What seemed lost is reborn. It is the moment of the solstice, of the favorable turn.
24.consejo: Trust in rebirth. What went away returns transformed. Allow yourself to start anew.

25.sig: Acting from natural spontaneity, without ulterior motives. Innocence connects with the essential order of things.
25.consejo: Be natural, do not calculate. Act from clean intention. What is spontaneous now is what is right.

26.sig: Great energy contained and tamed. Like a wild horse broken in, brute strength is channeled toward constructive purposes.
26.consejo: Accumulate energy without dispersing. Tame your impulses. Well-channeled strength is unstoppable.

27.sig: What nurtures, what is assimilated. Both physical and mental and spiritual nourishment. Care for what enters and what is sustained.
27.consejo: Watch what you nurture in yourself: food, ideas, relationships. What you assimilate builds or destroys you.

28.sig: A burden greater than the available forces. The situation is critical and requires extraordinary measures. It cannot be sustained for long.
28.consejo: Recognize the overload. Take exceptional measures. Reduce what weighs before it gives way.

29.sig: Double water, repeated danger. Like water that flows without stopping, one must pass through danger while maintaining integrity.
29.consejo: Do not freeze before danger. Flow like water, keep your essence. The abyss is crossed, not avoided.

30.sig: Double fire, clarity that illuminates. Fire needs fuel; clarity requires something to cling to. Shine with purpose.
30.consejo: Seek clarity. Illuminate what surrounds you. Understanding is your torch now.

31.sig: Reciprocal attraction between opposites. The mountain and the lake influence each other. It is the hexagram of falling in love and subtle influence.
31.consejo: Allow yourself to be influenced and to influence. Mutual attraction opens doors. The chemistry is real.

32.sig: What lasts because it follows its nature. Duration is not rigidity but constancy in change. Like the sun that rises each day.
32.consejo: Maintain constancy in what is essential. Duration is born of coherence, not of stagnation.

33.sig: Strategic retreat before superior forces. It is not cowardice but wisdom: withdrawing in time to preserve what is essential.
33.consejo: Retreat with elegance. Do not confront what surpasses you. Today prudence is courage.

34.sig: Great power, imposing strength. But true power is not imposed with violence but manifested with rectitude.
34.consejo: Use your power with rectitude. Strength without ethics turns against you. Imposing is easy; persuading is wise.

35.sig: Like the sun rising in the sky, progress is visible and luminous. A time of advance with recognition.
35.consejo: Advance with confidence. Your progress will be recognized. Shine without dazzling.

36.sig: The light is hidden beneath the earth. Adverse times when it is wise to keep your own light and not display it. Protect what is essential.
36.consejo: Hide your light for now. Do not expose yourself. Protect your essence until the light returns.

37.sig: Order within the family. Each member in their role. Domestic harmony is the foundation of every external enterprise.
37.consejo: Attend to your home and your close ones. Each one in their role. Internal harmony sustains the external.

38.sig: Opposing forces that do not easily reconcile. Opposition can be creative if the difference is respected without trying to annul it.
38.consejo: Accept the difference. Do not try to uniformize. Sometimes opposites complement each other from a distance.

39.sig: The path is blocked. Advancing directly is impossible. It is wise to seek help or an alternative route.
39.consejo: Do not force the obstacle. Seek a shortcut or an ally. Sometimes it is wise to go back to find another way.

40.sig: After the obstruction comes liberation. Tensions loosen and the path clears. A time to breathe and let go.
40.consejo: Take advantage of the relief. Release what was tense. Do not stay trapped in what has already given way.

41.sig: Reducing the superfluous to strengthen the essential. Conscious decrease is a form of wealth: fewer things, more substance.
41.consejo: Simplify. Reduce the unnecessary. The essential is strengthened when the accessory is removed.

42.sig: What has been given returns multiplied. It is a time of growth and expansion, especially when shared.
42.consejo: Take advantage of the growth. Share what has been gained. What increases with generosity endures.

43.sig: One must break once and for all with what has been dragging on. Firm and decisive resolution, but without unnecessary violence.
43.consejo: Make the decision you have been postponing. Be firm and clear. But do not lose your composure.

44.sig: An unexpected encounter, sometimes with something or someone tempting. One must discern whether it is fitting or a trap.
44.consejo: Look carefully at whom or what you encounter. Do not be seduced by appearances. Discern before committing.

45.sig: Forces gather around a center. It is a time to gather, group, and synthesize what is dispersed.
45.consejo: Convene, gather, organize. What is dispersed finds its center. But be careful who leads the congregation.

46.sig: Like a tree growing upward, it is a time to ascend, to rise in level. Growth is organic and sustained.
46.consejo: Rise with patience, like the tree. Each step elevates you. Do not skip stages; grow from the root.

47.sig: A feeling of exhaustion and constriction. Words do not convince and energy is lacking. One must seek internal resources.
47.consejo: Do not be discouraged. Oppression is temporary. Seek within yourself the resources that the outside denies you.

48.sig: The communal well that nourishes everyone. Structures change but the well remains. Connect with the essential source.
48.consejo: Return to the source. Drink from the essential. Clean the well of your life so the water becomes drinkable again.

49.sig: Radical and profound change. Like a snake shedding its skin, the old must be abandoned for the new to be born. Change is necessary.
49.consejo: Dare to make profound change. No patches, real transformation. The old no longer serves; release it with courage.

50.sig: The cauldron where sacred foods are cooked. Alchemical transformation of the raw into the cooked, of the crude into the cultivated.
50.consejo: Cook over a slow fire what you want to transform. Alchemy requires patience. The raw becomes wise in the cauldron.

51.sig: Double thunder, a startle that awakens. Shocks shake what is established and reveal what is truly important.
51.consejo: Let the startle awaken you. What is shaken shows you the essential. Do not be terrified; be grateful.

52.sig: Double mountain, profound stillness. Stopping at the right moment. Meditation and full presence are the way now.
52.consejo: Stop. Meditate. Still your mind. Stillness is not inaction but full presence.

53.sig: Like a tree growing on a hillside, development is slow but steady. The gradual well done leads to solidity.
53.consejo: Advance step by step, without haste. The gradual endures. Every small improvement counts.

54.sig: A union where roles are unequal. One must accept asymmetries with humility, knowing that each relationship has its own logic.
54.consejo: Accept role differences. Not all unions are symmetrical. Adjust your expectations to reality.

55.sig: A moment of fullness and abundance. Like the sun at noon, everything shines. One must take advantage because every peak precedes the decline.
55.consejo: Enjoy fullness without clinging. Take advantage of abundance while it lasts. Share so it lasts longer.

56.sig: Like a traveler in a strange land, one must stay light and prudent. It is not a time to put down roots but to transit.
56.consejo: Stay light. Do not cling. You are passing through. Be prudent as one who travels through foreign lands.

57.sig: Double wind, subtle and penetrating influence. The gentle penetrates where the strong cannot. Silent persuasion is powerful.
57.consejo: Influence without imposing. Gentleness penetrates. Like the wind that slips through every crack.

58.sig: Double lake, serenity and joy. Shared joy strengthens bonds. Communication flows naturally.
58.consejo: Cultivate shared joy. Communicate with serenity. Joy is contagious and healing.

59.sig: The rigid dissolves and flows again. Like ice melting into water. Tensions loosen and energy recovers its flow.
59.consejo: Let rigidities dissolve. Do not cling to structures that no longer flow. Fluidity is recovered.

60.sig: Establishing clear limits and moderation. Without restrictions everything overflows, but with excess of limits everything suffocates.
60.consejo: Set healthy limits. Neither overflowing nor rigidity. Moderation is freedom well understood.

61.sig: The truth that resides within. When there is deep sincerity, external actions become effective without effort.
61.consejo: Connect with your inner truth. Be integral. Sincerity moves mountains without the need to push.

62.sig: One must attend to small details. It is not a time for grand gestures but for care in what is modest.
62.consejo: Attend to details. Be humble. Small actions well done are worth more than large ones poorly done.

63.sig: Everything is in its place, order has been achieved. But the danger now is to relax and take for granted what has been conquered. Vigilance must be maintained.
63.consejo: Enjoy what has been achieved but do not relax. Maintain vigilance. What has been conquered can be lost if you become complacent.

64.sig: You are on the threshold, almost but not yet. It is a moment of maximum potential. One must maintain the effort until the end.
64.consejo: Do not give up in the final stretch. You are close but have not yet arrived. Maintain effort and attention.

narrativa.s1_asc: The first impression you offer the world is marked by your Ascendant in ${ascS}: ${sqAsc}.
narrativa.s1_mascara: It is the mask you wear effortlessly, your visible wrapping, and also the lens through which you filter everything life brings you.
narrativa.s1_sol: Behind that mask burns your Sun in ${solS}, the unrenounceable core of who you are: ${sqSol}.
narrativa.s1_solLuz: It is the light you seek to embody, the essential identity that makes you feel authentic when you live it fully.
narrativa.s1_lunaConj: And what is truly remarkable is that your Moon is also in ${solS}, merging with your Sun in a conjunction experienced as a natal New Moon.
narrativa.s1_lunaConj2: Your conscious identity and your emotional needs beat in unison in ${solSLower}, creating an inner coherence of uncommon intensity: you know what you feel and you feel what you are.
narrativa.s1_lunaConj3: All the force of ${sqSol} is concentrated in you massively, giving you solid self-knowledge but also concentrating the evolutionary tension in a single sign.
narrativa.s1_contrasteAscSol: However, the contrast with your Ascendant is evident: though outwardly you project ${eiAsc}, your inner world is ${eiSol}.
narrativa.s1_contrasteAscSol2: That distance between appearance and core is exactly the terrain where your evolution plays out, the space where you discover yourself and learn to reconcile what you show with what you are.
narrativa.s1_coherencia: The coherence between your appearance and your core gives you a solid and magnetic presence, though at times it may be hard to surprise yourself or step outside of who you are.
narrativa.s1_luna: In the deepest place, your Moon in ${lunaS} governs what you do not always show: ${sqLuna}.
narrativa.s1_lunaRefugio: It is the emotional refuge where you nurture and rest, the part that governs your instinctive reactions and your most intimate needs.
narrativa.s1_contrasteSolLuna: The contrast between your centre and your emotionality is vivid: your Sun burns in ${etSol} while your Moon flows with ${etLuna}.
narrativa.s1_polaridad1: That inner polarity is at once your wealth and your tension, for one part of you seeks ${buscaSol} while another needs ${necesitaLuna}.
narrativa.s1_triangulacion: Despite this, the triangulation is completed by your Ascendant: though you show ${eiAsc} to the world, inside you live between ${eiSol} and ${eiLuna}.
narrativa.s1_triangulacion2: That contrast gives you depth and mystery: you are not what you appear at first glance, and the journey of discovering yourself is an essential part of your path.
narrativa.s1_eje: These three energies draw the axis on which everything else in your chart rests: the mask, the core and the refuge, each with its own colour yet forming a unique identity.
narrativa.s2_predominio: Your character is steeped in the predominance of the ${domEl} element (${domElC} placements), which translates into ${etDom}.
narrativa.s2_concentrado: It is such an intense concentration that ${eiDom} is practically your natural element, the space where you feel at home and where your energy flows effortlessly.
narrativa.s2_tendencia: It is a clear tendency that shades your way of being in the world.
narrativa.s2_ausencia: The total absence of ${weakEl} is revealing: ${etWeak} does not come naturally, so you will have to cultivate it consciously throughout your life.
narrativa.s2_debil: The ${weakEl} element appears barely ${weakElC} time, a sensitive point that deserves care and attention.
narrativa.s2_debil2: The ${weakEl} element is present though to a lesser degree (${weakElC}), providing a counterpoint to your dominant tendency.
narrativa.s2_modalidad: The way you move through life bears a ${domMod} stamp (${domModC}): ${mtDom}.
narrativa.s2_yang: Yang energy predominates (${masculine}/${feminine}), so action and outwardness come naturally to you, though you must remember that true strength also knows how to stop and listen.
narrativa.s2_yin: Yin energy predominates (${feminine}/${masculine}), so receptivity and introspection are your refuge, though you must remember to step out into the world and manifest what is sown in silence.
narrativa.s2_equilibrio: The balance between yang and yin (${masculine}/${feminine}) gives you a stable base from which you can choose consciously.
narrativa.s2_stellium: Stellium. Curiously, much of your vital energy is concentrated in the realm of ${areaStellium}, where ${numPlanetas} planets gather: ${planetasLista}.
narrativa.s2_stellium2: This concentration turns that area into the main engine of your life: it is where you feel the greatest pressure, but also where your greatest potential resides.
narrativa.s2_stellium3: It is no coincidence that so many inner voices point to the same place —the chart shows you where your deepest transformation passes through.
narrativa.s2_noStellium: There are no extreme concentrations in your chart: your energy is spread across several areas, giving you versatility and preventing any single zone from monopolising your existence.
narrativa.s4_sinAspectos: No tight tense aspects are detected in your chart, which indicates your energy flows with a predominant harmony. This gives you a serene base, though it invites you to voluntarily cultivate the drive that tension usually grants.
narrativa.s4_conj2: ${desc1Cap} and ${desc2} merge within you, creating an inseparable alliance.
narrativa.s4_conj3: This fusion gives you uncommon potency in that area of your life, but the true challenge lies in integrating both voices without either silencing the other.
narrativa.s4_opp2: You feel a constant tug-of-war between ${desc1} and ${desc2}.
narrativa.s4_opp3: The challenge is not to choose one side and repress the other, but to hold the tension until both forces feed each other and you learn to inhabit the paradox.
narrativa.s4_sq2: The friction between ${desc1} and ${desc2} feels like a constant rubbing within you.
narrativa.s4_sq3: Yet that discomfort is the engine of your growth: what is hard to integrate is exactly what matures you and gives you depth.
narrativa.s4_tri3: This alliance is a gift: both forces empower each other effortlessly, and your challenge is not to take them for granted but to use them consciously.
narrativa.s4_sex2: There is an open channel between ${desc1} and ${desc2}, an opportunity that asks to be activated.
narrativa.s4_sex3: The ease is there, but you must take the initiative to seize it.
narrativa.s5_nodoN: Your evolution calls you toward the North Node in ${signo}: ${sqSigno}.
narrativa.s5_nodoN2: It is the direction that scares you because it is new, but it is also the one that expands you and returns you to who you are called to be.
narrativa.s5_nodoS: From it you bid farewell to the South Node in ${signo}, the comfort zone you already master and from which you must detach so as not to stagnate.
narrativa.s5_lilith: Your instinctive and wild power resides in Lilith in ${signo}: ${sqSigno}, the part of you that asks to be recognised without shame or domestication.
narrativa.s5_fortuna: And your flow of luck shines in the Part of Fortune in ${signo}, the realm where natural joy awaits you when you align your identity, your emotion and your way of presenting yourself to the world.
narrativa.s6_yang: Your chart burns in yang: remember that true strength also knows how to stop and listen to itself.
narrativa.s6_yin: Your chart flows in yin: remember that what is sown in silence also asks to be manifested in the world.
narrativa.s6_equil: Your chart balances impulse and containment: choose consciously from that solid base.
narrativa.s6_stellium: The concentration in the area of ${areaStellium} is your compass and your load: your greatest potential lies there.
narrativa.s6_cierre: The chart is a map, not a sentence —what seems tension is raw material for your growth, and the only true magic is to choose, with full awareness, who you want to be.
narrativa.s2b_stelliumSigno: Almost every path in your chart converges on ${signo}: ${planetasLista}. All that energy is colored by ${sqSigno}, making this sign the dominant accent of your personality.
narrativa.s2b_tsquare: Your chart draws a T-square between ${p1} and ${p2}, with ${p3} at the apex: a triangle of tension that shakes you awake and, well lived, becomes your greatest engine of achievement.
narrativa.s2b_granTrigono: There is also a grand ${elemento} trine formed by ${planetasLista}: a circle of grace where your energy flows without obstacles; your challenge is not to fall asleep in comfort but to put that gift to work on something concrete.
narrativa.s4_desc_asc: the way you show yourself to the world
narrativa.s5_nodoNCasa: And that evolutionary path plays out mainly in the realm of ${area}, the zone of your life where you are asked to grow, even when it feels uncomfortable at first.
narrativa.s5_quiron: Your wound and your healing gift live in Chiron in ${signo}: ${sqSigno}. What once hurt in ${area} is exactly where you can help others heal.
narrativa.s6_weak: Consciously cultivate the ${weakEl} element (${etWeak}): it is your pending energetic assignment.
narrativa.s6_tenso: And remember that the friction between ${p1} and ${p2} is not your enemy: it is the edge that makes you grow.
narrativa.avisoFinal: This analysis is a symbolic interpretation of your natal chart. Take it as a mirror for reflection and self-knowledge, not as a deterministic forecast.

aspectos.Opposition: Polarity: tension between opposites that asks for integration and balance.
aspectos.Quincunx: Awkward adjustment (150°): energies that rub and demand constant adaptation.

conceptos.stellium: A concentration of 3 or more planets in the same house or sign: an intense focus of energy in that area of your life.
conceptos.masculino: Active, yang energies (Fire and Air): outward drive, action and mind.
conceptos.femenino: Receptive, yin energies (Earth and Water): containment, emotion and matter.
conceptos.fuego: Element of action, passion, creativity and will. Initiative and transformation.
conceptos.tierra: Element of stability, matter, practicality and constancy. The tangible and real.
conceptos.aire: Element of mind, communication, ideas and social relations. Thought and logic.
conceptos.agua: Element of emotion, intuition, sensitivity and deep connection. The inner world.
conceptos.cardinal: Mode of initiation: energy that starts, leads and opens new cycles.
conceptos.fijo: Mode of stability: energy that sustains, persists and maintains.
conceptos.mutable: Mode of adaptation: flexible energy that flows, adjusts and transitions.

medioCielo.desc: The highest point of the chart (10th House cusp): your vocation, public image and life purpose.

ascendente.desc: The sign rising on the eastern horizon at your birth (1st House cusp): how you present yourself and your first impression.
